# D8_PARITY_TAPE_20261110_ASIA: NQ trade records of the Asia session of trading date 20261110 (18:00 ET 2026-11-09 to 02:00 ET 2026-11-10), research data only
Source: the engine trade store (one row per exchange trade record, CME MBO action T), contract NQZ6 (no roll in this session). Columns: time_ns_utc = record timestamp in nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC; price in points; size in contracts; side_d8 = D8 aggressor side of the record from the book quote at the trade (+1 buy: last >= ask, -1 sell: last <= bid, 0 none; buy test first; locked/crossed = buy). 51093 records.
To rebuild bars: merge consecutive records with the same price and the same side_d8 into one print (no time condition; never across the session boundary), stamp it with the time the run is KNOWN complete (the time of the next record of a different price or side; the last run of the session: its last record), then apply the bar rules of D8_BUILD_SPEC.md. Parity bar files: D8_PARITY_<id>_20261110.md.
